fusions.name: Weir Snap
fusions.desc: Shuts a weir on a target up to 5 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Shut Sluice
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: it deals 20 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up.

fusions.name: Stillwater Pen
fusions.desc: Sets a pen of still water 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Warden's Due
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
